part.text: All 20 test suites pass. Quick sanity check on the reported repro case:

Fixed. The bug was in `formatter<group_digits_view<T>>::format` in include/fmt/format.h:4199 — the value was cast directly to an unsigned type, so negative integers wrapped around to their two's-complement value (e.g. `-12345` → `18446744073709539271`).

The fix mirrors how `make_write_int_arg` (include/fmt/format.h:2136) handles signedness elsewhere:
- Computes the absolute value (`grouped_abs_value = 0 - grouped_abs_value` when negative)
- Adds a `-` sign via `detail::prefix_append`, so the sign is counted in width/padding accounting and printed before the digits

Verified: `fmt::group_digits(-12345)` → `-12,345`, `group_digits(-1000)` with `{ :8}` → `  -1,000`, and all 20 test suites pass with no regressions.
